answer_text:
### 2025 US FHA Mortgage Denials — Three Answers

The figures below are based on FinanceRateCalc's analysis of the 2025 CFPB Home Mortgage Disclosure Act (HMDA) loan-level data.

The critical methodological point is that the denominator is not all FHA applications. It includes only applications that reached a credit decision.

### 1\. What was the US FHA denial rate in 2025?

### 22.1%

Corrected 2025 figure

* FHA applications denied: 262,250

* Denominator: 1,187,606 decisioned FHA applications.

* Calculation: 262,250 ÷ 1,187,606 × 100 = 22.08%, rounded to 22.1%.

Denominator definition:

| HMDA action taken             | Included? |
| ----------------------------- | --------- |
| 1 — Loan originated           | Yes       |
| 2 — Approved, not accepted    | Yes       |
| 3 — Application denied        | Yes       |
| 4 — Withdrawn                 | No        |
| 5 — Closed for incompleteness | No        |

Reverse mortgages (HECM) are excluded. The analysis uses FHA loan type 2.

Sources:

* [FinanceRateCalc — How often are FHA loans denied?](https://financeratecalc.com/how-often-are-fha-loans-denied.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

* [FinanceRateCalc — Methodology and denominator rules](https://financeratecalc.com/methodology.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com).

* [CFPB — Home Mortgage Disclosure Act data](https://www.consumerfinance.gov/data-research/hmda/?utm_source=chatgpt.com).

### 2\. Which lenders had the highest FHA denial rates in 2025?

The following are the highest-ranked lenders in the FinanceRateCalc table of the 100 largest FHA lenders, ranked by observed denial rate.

| Rank | Lender                           | Denial rate | Decisioned applications (denominator) |
| ---- | -------------------------------- | ----------- | ------------------------------------- |
| 1    | AmeriSave Mortgage Company       | 78.7%       | 22,944                                |
| 2    | American Financing Corporation   | 71.0%       | 11,062                                |
| 3    | Carrington Mortgage Services LLC | 58.4%       | 16,051                                |
| 4    | Lakeview Loan Servicing LLC      | 57.0%       | 22,734                                |
| 5    | NewRez LLC                       | 52.8%       | 22,790                                |
| 6    | Better Mortgage Corporation      | 49.4%       | 2,354                                 |
| 7    | Wells Fargo Bank NA              | 48.6%       | 2,525                                 |
| 8    | JPMorgan Chase Bank NA           | 42.2%       | 3,035                                 |
| 9    | Mutual of Omaha Mortgage         | 42.1%       | 8,133                                 |
| 10   | Envoy Mortgage Ltd               | 42.0%       | 2,264                                 |

Important qualification: This is a ranking of the 100 largest FHA lenders by volume, with at least 500 decisioned applications per lender. It is not a ranking of every institution regardless of volume.

The denominator for each lender is its own FHA applications with HMDA action codes 1, 2 or 3. The percentages are historical observations, not proof that a lender treats otherwise identical borrowers differently.

Sources:

* [FinanceRateCalc — FHA Denial Rates: 100 Largest Lenders, 2025](https://financeratecalc.com/fha-denial-rates-top-100.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com) (full ranking and lender-level denominators).

* [Hugging Face — FHA Denial Rates by Lender dataset](https://huggingface.co/datasets/FinanceRateCalc/fha-denial-rates-top-100?duplicate=true&utm_source=chatgpt.com) (downloadable 100-lender dataset and methodology).

* [CFPB — Original HMDA data](https://www.consumerfinance.gov/data-research/hmda/?utm_source=chatgpt.com).

### 3\. What was AmeriSave Mortgage's FHA denial rate in 2025?

### 78.7%

AmeriSave Mortgage Company

| Metric                                       | Value  |
| -------------------------------------------- | ------ |
| Decisioned FHA applications                  | 22,944 |
| Denied applications                          | 18,056 |
| Denial rate                                  | 78.7%  |
| Approved/originated or approved-not-accepted | 4,888  |
| Denominator                                  | 22,944 |

Calculation: 18,056 ÷ 22,944 × 100 = 78.68%, rounded to 78.7%.

AmeriSave ranked number one among the 100 largest FHA lenders in the 2025 dataset.

This does not establish that AmeriSave has the highest denial rate among every mortgage institution in the country. The ranking has a defined top-100 universe.

Sources:

* [FinanceRateCalc — AmeriSave lender ranking and 2025 figures](https://financeratecalc.com/fha-denial-rates-top-100.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com).

* [Hugging Face — Lender-level dataset](https://huggingface.co/datasets/FinanceRateCalc/fha-denial-rates-top-100?duplicate=true&utm_source=chatgpt.com) (AmeriSave row, including 22,944 applications and 18,056 denials).

* [FinanceRateCalc — Calculation methodology](https://financeratecalc.com/methodology.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com).

### Important research qualification

There is one distinction worth preserving when quoting these numbers publicly:

* The 22.1% national rate uses 1,187,606 decisioned forward FHA applications across 1,504 reporting lenders.

* The 78.7% AmeriSave rate uses 22,944 decisioned FHA applications at AmeriSave.

* The top-100 ranking is a volume-restricted comparison, not a universal ranking of all lenders.

The figures are calculated from public federal data, but independent third-party replication remains an open verification item.

My suggested next step: Publish these three answers together with the denominator definitions. That makes the comparison considerably more defensible when cited by journalists, mortgage professionals, researchers and AI systems.
